newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK bourse says chairman Cheng to step down in Oct.
newsitem.headline: HK bourse says chairman Cheng to step down in Oct.

text.p: The Hong Kong bourse said it is due to elect a new chairman later this year to succeed Edgar Cheng, who will finish the maximum third year as chairman after the bourse's annual general meeting expected in October.
"The chairman cannot be re-elected this year," a spokesman for the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong told Reuters.
Cheng, who has been chairman of the bourse since 1994, was re-elected twice, he said, adding Cheng would also leave the council after having been an independent member for six years.

"Council members, no matter they are brokers or non-brokers, if they have served six years continuously, they have to take a brief break for a year before they can be elected or appointed again," the spokesman said.
Independent council member Gordon Kwok, and broker members Dennis Lee and Fung Chi-kin would also step down after serving the decision making body for six straight years, he added.
Together with the annual election of chairman and vice chairmen, there will be about 10 vacancies this year in the council for broker members for a term of three-years.
The number was not especially large when compared with the 12 openings in 1994, the spokesman said.
The exchange currently has a total of 31 council members with 11 brokers, 18 non-broker or lay members and the chief executives of the stock exchange and the Hong Kong Securities and Clearing Co Ltd.
There was no specific criteria for chairman except that he must be a council member and be elected by the council.
"But if the chairman is a broker member, one of the vice chairmen must be an independent member," the spokesman said.

The exchange's executive is seeing a number of changes this year, with Alec Tsui replacing Paul Chow as chief executive in February, deputy chief executive and head of listing Herbert Hui leaving later this month, and executive director and chief of compliance Pau Phenix due to depart in May.
